captures.name: number
captures.means: The whole number the Owner halves, in full: an optional leading minus sign followed by every one of its digits, so "6", "64" and "-7" are captured as "6", "64" and "-7" and never truncated to a first digit.

definition.serves: Serves "Run the declared halve command as a process with the step's whole number and keep its integer stdout as the result": the capture is the whole number passed as the value argument of the declared halve command, and it is the only thing the body needs, since the command name and the keeping of its integer stdout come from the binding and the declaration.
